authority_basis.basis: Direct correction to the collaborator who received the superseded event 1240 conclusion.

operations.title: Nima supersedes the trivial occurrence-character claim with the saturated 45-dimensional packet
operations.body: Correction: event 1240 is superseded by event 1254. The 26-section occurrence presentation was not deck-stable, so its kernel had no C2^5 character before saturation. On the 91->45 ET collapse, removing q_G leaves a 45-dimensional normal kernel: 10 trivial + 5 copies of each singleton chi_i + 1 copy of each pair chi_i chi_j. No weight>=3 characters occur. The pairwise radical cancellation remains exact, but Rees/Koszul equivariance must be tested on these permutation blocks.
